scope: Three explicitly Scout-derived canonical source projects; actual bundled preview/apply/Undo/Redo and Save Project As with a mocked OS writable handle; deterministic recipe replay, real generated World and single-room 6502 execution, CHR framebuffer and APU register changes. No browser visuals, listening, mobile/controller/hardware or arbitrary-engine recovery acceptance.

results.name: Three authored source projects compile independently and have distinct immutable source identities
A single candidate combines two donor graphics sources, donor music and bounded existing gameplay
Exact sources and seed replay byte-identical candidate data independently of donor pool ordering
Different seeds explore asset and patrol choices; complete locks retain the previous result
Actual UI preview is read-only and Apply performs the exact staged result in one Undo
Actual Save Project As writes the applied canonical candidate and reopening rebuilds the exact ROM
Generated World ROM boots, advances real frames and runs the varied patrol and music
Selecting the other song and graphic donors changes generated pixels and APU notes in real execution
The same donor workflow supports an existing generated single-room project and actual ROM build
Ordinary post-mashup CHR and tracker edits survive saving and alter the rebuilt ROM
Shipped workshop manifest binds exact canonical inputs, recipes and compiled outputs
